clips.title: The story
paras: Lakeshire is the primary human settlement in the Redridge Mountains, nestled along the northern shores of Lake Everstill. Led by Magistrate Solomon and guarded by Marshal Marris, the picturesque town is currently on the brink of collapse due to relentless assaults by Blackrock orcs, aggressive gnoll packs, and shoreline murlocs.

Once a peaceful haven in the foothills east of Stormwind, Lakeshire has become the kingdom's most embattled frontier. The town's garrison at Stonewatch Keep was brutally overrun by Blackrock clan orcs sweeping down from the north, and dark wizardry has riled local Shadowhide gnoll packs into organized raiding parties. Blackrock saboteurs have even shattered parts of the Everstill Bridge, leaving Foreman Oslow and his crew struggling to repair the span while under constant threat of attack. With murlocs choking the lake's shores and gnolls stalking the high passes, Lakeshire's defenders are stretched to their breaking point.
